description: Mint a working sandbox API key with no signup and no human in the loop. Returns an apiKey (flw_test_...), an organizationId, a seeded company with a Peppol id, and suggested next steps. Sandbox data is synthetic and never reaches a real network - never send real personal data to it. This key gives no access to any real account.

includeNextSteps.description: Include the suggested next-step instructions in the result. Default true. Set false when you already know the flow and only want the credential.

name: sandbox_create_credential
